reviewer: Claude (Anthropic), visual review of simulated card crops
method: Every approved cover was cropped as the card shows it (object-fit: cover in a frame of about 1.07:1) and viewed on labelled contact sheets, together with automated checks for missing files, external links, duplicate files, near-duplicate images, resolution and orientation. A focus point moves the crop; a withdrawal returns the card to the Heritage Bridge fallback.

checkedWithoutChange: No missing rendition files; no card or gallery image is served from an external host.

No Commons file is used on two cards. Samarra and the Great Mosque of Samarra both show the Malwiya in different photographs: the minaret stands within the site, so this is a related view, not a misassignment.
The near-duplicate signal between Aghawat Mosque and Imam Dur Mausoleum is a false positive (a minaret at night and a mausoleum by day).
Shifting the crop of Samarra and of the Great Mosque of Samarra made them worse; their centred crops stay.
No watermarks seen. Images use object-fit: cover (cards, thumbnails) or contain with height auto (viewer), so none is stretched.

Small originals kept, as they show the right site and read acceptably at card size: Mar Behnam 384 px, Haydar-Khana 375 px, Baghdad Central Station 400 px, Bash Tapia 500 px. Better photographs would improve them on high-density screens.
Dailam Monastery, Qishla of Kirkuk and Shamash School were re-made from their full originals (640, 495 and 710 px) after a rate-limited first download.
